verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a hardware/silicon platform with an accompanying SDK (Ryzen AI, Lemonade, GAIA) for developers to build AI applications; it is not itself an end-user product that ingests 'my data' and surfaces AI-generated insights/suggestions inside a UI. This story targets application-level agentic features, which is a category mismatch for a CPU/NPU chip.
